nodes.title: 1. Creative brief
widgets_values:
Create exactly one continuous 10-second realistic live-action cable-news split-screen discussion grounded only in the three supplied references. Use exactly two independently tracked people and no one else. <Picture 1> supplies only the locked split-screen news-studio composition, left-right blocking, camera height, backgrounds, and lighting. Do not reproduce its logo, lower-third, branding, captions, or visible text. <Subject 1> is the left speaker from <Picture 2>. <Subject 2> is the right speaker from <Picture 3>. Preserve their faces, hair, suits, shirts, ties, microphones, proportions, and left-right positions.

The fictional discussion draws on the moral premise of the Injustice comic series: superpowered people become dangerous when their power places them beyond institutional accountability. No superhero, costume, illustration, or B-roll appears.

Use one locked medium split-screen shot with no cuts, zooms, pans, reframing, or transitions. <Subject 1> looks into camera with measured concern and says exactly, “Supermen roaming the country unchecked could impose their will anywhere.” He closes his lips and listens. After a short natural beat, <Subject 2> gives a restrained nod and replies gravely, “If no one can hold them accountable, raw power becomes law.” His lips close. Use natural blinking, restrained head movement, precise lip synchronization, and no overlapping speech. The non-speaking subject remains attentive and silent. End with both men composed and concerned in the unchanged split-screen. Exactly one shot and exactly two English dialogue lines.

5. MiniMax-H3 target profile
widgets_values: Clean close-miked English broadcast voices with faint neutral studio room tone. Subject 1 speaks first, followed by a short natural pause, then Subject 2. No overlapping speech, narrator, voice-over, audience, crowd, broadcast sting, sound effects, or music.

Exactly two English lines, spoken verbatim. <Subject 1> (S1), measured concern: “Supermen roaming the country unchecked could impose their will anywhere.” <Subject 2> (S2), grave firmness: “If no one can hold them accountable, raw power becomes law.” S1 must finish before S2 begins. Do not add, omit, repeat, or paraphrase any words.

No additional people, superheroes, costumes, B-roll, cutaways, camera movement, split-screen drift, subject swapping, duplicated faces, blended identities, changed wardrobe, contact-sheet grids, labels, logos, lower-thirds, captions, subtitles, visible text, warped mouths, listening-subject lip movement, overlapping dialogue, narration, audience noise, or music.

nodes.title: 5a. Reference roles - Auto or contact sheet
widgets_values:
<Picture 1>: [dg:count,environment,lighting,spatial,composition,camera,text] sole authority for the locked two-person split-screen broadcast composition, left-right blocking, camera height, newsroom backgrounds, and studio lighting; do not transfer its logo, lower-third, captions, branding, or visible text.
<Picture 2>: [dg:identity,appearance,object,color] sole authority for <Subject 1>, the left speaker's face, brown side-parted hair, navy suit, white shirt, burgundy patterned tie, and lapel microphone; preserve fully and do not duplicate or blend.
<Picture 3>: [dg:identity,appearance,object,color] sole authority for <Subject 2>, the right speaker's face, gray side-parted hair, black suit, white shirt, pale violet tie, pocket square, and lapel microphone; preserve fully and do not duplicate or blend.
